info.title: UniNotes API
info.description: REST API for UniNotes. Authentication uses an HttpOnly session cookie. State-changing requests from a signed-in session must send the X-CSRF-Token header (value from GET /api/auth/session). Successful JSON responses are wrapped as { data, meta? }; errors as { error: { code, message, details? } }.
